description: Eva Samper arrives as the first girl at José María Root and immediately overturns the boys' assumptions about women, sex, literature and politics. Camilo falls in love with her while Castro, Salcedo, Pabón and Arbeláez are pulled into the new friendships and conflicts she provokes; Camilo's encounter with Luisa creates consequences he cannot keep separate from Eva. As Eva's guarded family background comes into view, her presence changes both the school and the group, ending with secrets exposed and her sudden departure.

s01e01.description: Eva Samper becomes the first girl admitted to José María Root, immediately unsettling Camilo, Martín, Gustavo, Álvaro and Rodrigo and challenging the assumptions that structure their all-male school life. Camilo is captivated by her confidence and reading, while his father's attempt to initiate him into adulthood only makes his growing feelings for Eva clearer.

s01e02.description: Convinced that Eva's sophistication must conceal something, Camilo and the boys follow her and wrongly conclude that she is a prostitute. Eva discovers the surveillance, turns the embarrassment back on them and draws them into a bowling outing, while uncertainty over whether she will be allowed to remain at the school raises the stakes of the friendship.

s01e03.description: Eva's presence pushes the boys into a Mother's Day project that exposes both their immaturity and problems inside their families. Martín's attempt to pass off someone else's song as his own unravels, and an affair involving his family becomes public, leaving Estela and the school community dealing with the consequences.

s01e04.description: Eva and Camilo use the school newspaper to expose the misconduct surrounding Estela, earning themselves suspension while the adults fight over what should remain private. Eva tells Camilo about her mother's suicide and the absence of her father, and the dispute escalates when Estela shoots the man she blames for what happened and is taken into custody.

s01e05.description: With Estela's freedom depending on whether the shooting can be understood as self-defense, Eva and Camilo investigate the violence that preceded it and find evidence supporting her account. Soon after their suspension is reversed, Eva is abducted in front of Camilo, abruptly turning his doubts about her background into a real danger.

s01e06.description: Camilo and José report Eva's kidnapping, but José's confrontation with the police gets him jailed while Eva unexpectedly returns and claims the abductors made a mistake. Her poor grades then threaten her place at José María Root, leading her to study with Guzmán and develop feelings for the boy the rest of the group has been mocking.

s01e07.description: Guzmán leaves after using Eva for his own academic advantage, prompting the boys to investigate the inconsistencies in her story more seriously. They discover her wealthy home, learn that her father is an industrialist and that the kidnapping was genuine, and hear the truth about her mother's suicide and repeated expulsions; Martín's sister Luisa then becomes the school's second female student.

s01e08.description: Street protests, inflation and José's union activity bring national politics directly into Camilo's home and the students' conversations. Short of money, the boys accept Eva's help, while Camilo uses Luisa in an increasingly reckless attempt to make Eva jealous and turns a classroom discussion of Nietzsche into another contest over her attention.

s01e09.description: Camilo finally gets an opportunity to express his feelings for Eva, but his earlier attempt to provoke jealousy leaves him entangled with Luisa instead. He sleeps with Luisa at Eva's house and then tries to retreat from what he has done, provoking anger from both Eva and Martín and damaging the trust he had been building.

s01e10.description: Eva intervenes when Camilo's conflict with Martín over Luisa becomes physical, while Luisa is sent away to boarding school. At a party Camilo again tries to tell Eva how he feels, but the night is diverted by a call for help and by Camilo accidentally discovering Gustavo and Martín in an intimate encounter they are desperate to keep private.

s01e11.description: Rumors about Martín and Gustavo spread after Quiñónez learns what happened, and Camilo lies in an attempt to protect Martín by placing the blame on Gustavo. Eva and Ana push back against the group's intolerance; Camilo eventually admits the truth, and Gustavo leaves Bogotá after reconciling with the friends who had helped turn his private life into a crisis.

s01e12.description: Eva catches the Acuña twins stealing and recruits them with Camilo for a break-in intended to alter school grades, a scheme that finally brings Eva and Camilo to a kiss. The victory lasts only briefly: Eva's father is arrested for money laundering, and she learns that she will be sent to the United States rather than remain in Colombia.

s01e13.description: Eva and Camilo run away to Neusa rather than accept her departure, but the police find them and their friends can only hide Eva temporarily. Adela ultimately reveals where she is, Eva is sent to the United States before Camilo can arrange to follow her, and Luisa then calls with news that she may be pregnant.
